figures.caption: Figure 4: Illustrating the DP cost model from Algorithm 2 at join node 𝑢. Starting from the input plan (left) where both filters are pushed down, the DP considers pulling SF2 up to 𝑢. (1) Distribute SF1 to 𝐿, leaving 𝑅 unfiltered. (2) Add relational cost of 𝑢, scaled by 𝛼 and reduced by 𝑠1. (3) Place SF2 at 𝑢; the join eliminates unmatched tuples, so the number of distinct 𝑅-tuples at 𝑢.
